description: Nowledge Mem lifecycle hooks — Context Bundle / Working Memory injection and session capture for Copilot CLI

hooks.command: python3 -c "import os,pathlib,runpy,sys; h=os.environ.get('COPILOT_HOME'); h != '' or sys.exit('COPILOT_HOME must not be empty'); d=pathlib.Path(h) if h is not None else pathlib.Path.home()/'.copilot'; d.is_absolute() or not (d.root or d.drive) or sys.exit('COPILOT_HOME must identify a complete directory path'); d=d if d.is_absolute() else pathlib.Path.cwd()/d; r=os.environ.get('COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT') or os.environ.get('PLUGIN_ROOT') or os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT') or str(d/'nowledge-mem-hooks'); p=pathlib.Path(r)/'hooks'/'copilot-hook.py'; runpy.run_path(str((p if p.exists() else pathlib.Path(r)/'copilot-hook.py').resolve()), run_name='__main__')" --event session-start
